svg.title: remmy vs. rm by workload
svg.desc: macOS, warm cache, median of 12–20 runs. Higher is better. balanced-38k: remmy 60.3k files/s, rm 23.5k files/s (2.6x faster); balanced-152k: remmy 53.0k files/s, rm 22.7k files/s (2.3x faster); wide-38k: remmy 42.9k files/s, rm 20.5k files/s (2.1x faster); deep-38k: remmy 66.4k files/s, rm 27.1k files/s (2.5x faster); flat-38k: remmy 36.4k files/s, rm 35.0k files/s (no change); large-1mib-files: remmy 20.3k files/s, rm 13.3k files/s (1.5x faster); tiny-125: remmy 33.0k files/s, rm 25.2k files/s (1.3x faster)
svg.text: macOS, warm cache, median of 12–20 runs. Higher is better.
